exposure: antenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (ePAS)
diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum at the time of delivery (uPAS)
outcome: maternal packed red blood cell transfusion
cohort: The study included 92 cases of histopathologically proven invasive placentation (placenta accreta spectrum) from January 2011 to September 2021.
finding: Maternal hemorrhagic morbidity, specifically mean packed red blood cell transfusion, was significantly lower in expected PAS (ePAS) cases compared to unexpected PAS (uPAS) cases, despite ePAS cases having more highly invasive PAS.
